runtime_capture.capture_event: service-samples-v7 original DOS checkpoint at DoAntSim entry 1
runtime_capture.capture_range: physical 00000-FFFFF (1048576 bytes); font banks sliced from the first-megabyte DOS state
runtime_capture.interpretation: The reference machine uses the pinned US keyboard layout with no codepage overlay. The active 8x8 bank at C000:01E9 and 8x14 bank at C000:09E9 equal DOSBox-X v2026.08.31's static int10_font_08 and int10_font_14 initializers byte-for-byte. The mode-12h DAC defaults in slots 16..63 are separately captured from the same checkpoint's raw VGA palette.

render_capture.method: Derived from the captured US C09E9 bank for text bytes 32, 70, 105, 108, 101; rows are ordered as src/graphics/bitmap_text.asm L007F-L0093 moves them.
render_capture.reason: The retired bitmap capture was produced under the Czech overlay. The replacement checks the native projection against rows from the independently captured DOS BIOS bank and avoids retaining a Czech-rendered expected bitmap.

font_8x8.extraction: physical 0xC01E9..0xC09E8 from the pinned US v7 DOS first-megabyte checkpoint; equals static int10_font_08 in the pinned int10_memory.cpp

font_8x14.extraction: physical 0xC09E9..0xC17E8 from the pinned US v7 DOS first-megabyte checkpoint; equals static int10_font_14 in the pinned int10_memory.cpp and INT 10h AX=1130h BH=02

mode_12_dac_defaults_16_63.extraction: RGB6 bytes for VGA DAC entries 16..63 from raw indexed-vga-v7 entry-1 mode-12h checkpoint; entries 0..15 are game-written and entries 64..255 are unchanged

palette_capture.extraction: 144 bytes at offsets 160..303; validity bytes for slots 16..63 are all 1

unprovided_tables.font_8x16: The canonical source has no INT 10h AX=1130h BH=06 request. It is not consumed by this native port and is therefore not a runtime provider input. The upstream static initializer remains in int10_memory.cpp.

scope: BIOS service data for the pinned DOSBox-X acceptance machine; not a SIMANT game asset and not a claim about a physical PC BIOS.
